title: Annotating a Complete Genome with HMMs
author: Frank O Aylward
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.ytcfwiw

steps.title: Download and prepare tutorial files
steps.instruction: Clone the tutorial repository and navigate into the directory.

steps.title: Prepare protein and HMM database files
steps.instruction: Decompress the mystery genome proteins and download/extract the TIGRfam database.

substeps.instruction: Extract the tarball using `tar xvfz tigrfams.tar.gz`

steps.title: Perform HMM annotation
steps.instruction: Run the hmmsearch command using HMMER3 to annotate proteins using the TIGRfam database with pre-specified bit score cutoffs.

steps.title: Parse HMM search results
steps.instruction: Use a Python script to extract the best hits for each protein and convert the output to a tab-delimited format including TIGRfam descriptions.

steps.title: Annotate via KEGG KAAS server
steps.instruction: Perform an alternative genome annotation and pathway visualization using the KEGG server.

substeps.instruction: Upload the protein file and enter email address
Select the 'For Prokaryotes' option at the bottom of the page
Click the 'submit' option in the confirmation email received
Wait approximately 10-45 minutes for the final annotation link to be emailed
